a simple and effective technique for equalizing the currents in the layers of a layered-foil conductor is to use capacitance between layers as ballast impedance.
the capacitance method can be used to enforce equal current sharing in foil windings for frequencies above 1 MHz, which is the upper frequency limit for litz wire.
the new methods can provide a low-cost, high-frequency alternative to litz for applications where the foil layers can be kept relatively short, such as the primary winding of a transformer.
